C55716.observed: Re-run on 21 September 2026, QA branch sv9160, build v26.36.8-d146c39. Checked against the requirements page 576978945 version 17, re-read live the same day. Watched on the screen through the search box, not read from behind it, and every ordering reading was taken twice with the rounds agreeing. The requirement says that when two records are otherwise equal the one updated more recently comes first. It does not happen. Two customers alike in every way sit in a fixed order. I changed the SECOND one so it became the most recently updated, and confirmed the change had actually saved by reading it back. The order did not move, checked again after fifteen, thirty-five and sixty-five seconds. I then proved this was not my own doing: I renamed that same customer, and the new name appeared in the search within twenty-five seconds, so the search does pick up changes to this exact record. The name change shows; the position never does. The name was put back afterwards.
